title: RMF Bias Analysis
imageAlt: RMF Bias Analysis datathon project visual
description: TXST Datathon 2025 (3rd Place): analyzed 20K+ RateMyProfessor reviews using Python, Pandas, and Matplotlib to identify bias in grading leniency, sampling, and review extremity. Created 5+ visualizations and presented actionable recommendations to improve fairness in student evaluations.

title: Credit Risk Modeling
description: Built and evaluated classification models to predict credit default risk, including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost. The workflow includes EDA, class-imbalance handling (SMOTE and undersampling), and evaluation with ROC AUC, confusion matrix, precision, recall, and F1 score.
